Container.Name: Arcanist
Container.Overview:
Arcanist is a self-hosted, open source (AGPL-3.0) music server by LinkFast: a personal or family streaming service for your own music. Libraries from your shares, a web player, Subsonic/OpenSubsonic and mStream compatible apps, DLNA, playlists, ratings, mixes, audio analysis (BPM, key, loudness), transcoding with ffmpeg, backups and a P2P network to share libraries between servers.
First run: open the WebUI and follow the setup wizard. It asks for a setup code, printed in the container's log and saved as setup-code.txt in its appdata folder.
Music: map your music share to /music. Read-only is enough to listen; read-write lets Arcanist take uploads, organize and import. Add more paths if your music is in several shares.
DLNA needs Network Type: Host.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, settings, keys, caches, logs and setup-code.txt. Keep it on a local disk or a cache pool, never on a network share.

Config.Name: Music
Config.Description: Your music. Read-only (ro) to listen only; read-write (rw) for uploads, organizing and imports.
